answer: Sybil resistance follows from linking equivocation proofs across bonded identities: when k coordinated identities violate consensus, their pairwise correlations create O(k^2) penalty exposure, rather than k independent fines. Detection compounds that exposure through an exponential multiplier in capital loss, while asymmetric depreciation prevents rapid recovery of slashed collateral. The falcon verifier, kernel rules, and atlas of signed attestations make coordination auditable without treating mere shared infrastructure as proof of collusion.
